breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly corrects the error by stating to ignore the instruction that torsional shear stress is zero at the outer surface, and it proceeds to compute outer-surface torsional shear using τ = Tc/J. This matches the ground truth behavior, where no zero-shear assumption is included.
